ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Waste food daily
   B. Care for the environment and use resources wisely
   C. Pollute rivers deliberately
   D. Destroy trees without planting

2. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Hiding stolen items
   C. Cheating in exams
   D. Spreading rumours

3. Which response best shows understanding of Taqwa? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Taqwa.
   B. Apply the teaching of Taqwa with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Taqwa has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Taqwa to insult classmates of other faiths.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on dressing? (1 mark)
   A. Use Hadith on dressing to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Hadith on dressing has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on dressing with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on dressing.

5. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   B. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   C. Skipping all moral lessons
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

6. Which response best shows understanding of Zakat:? (1 mark)
   A. Say Zakat: has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Zakat:.
   C. Apply the teaching of Zakat: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Zakat: to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on planting? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on planting.
   B. Apply the teaching of Hadith on planting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   C. Say Hadith on planting has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Hadith on planting to insult classmates of other faiths.

8. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Purity of Actions? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on Purity of Actions has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Purity of Actions.
   C. Use Hadith on Purity of Actions to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Purity of Actions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

9. Which response best shows understanding of Saum? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Saum with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Saum has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Saum.
   D. Use Saum to insult classmates of other faiths.

10. Which response best shows understanding of Selected Surah? (1 mark)
   A. Use Selected Surah to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Selected Surah has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Selected Surah with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Selected Surah.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources.
   B. Use Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Say Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources has no place in daily life.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Stories of Prophets:? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Stories of Prophets: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stories of Prophets:.
   C. Say Stories of Prophets: has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Stories of Prophets: to insult classmates of other faiths.

13. Which response best shows understanding of Tawakkul? (1 mark)
   A. Use Tawakkul to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Tawakkul has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Tawakkul.
   D. Apply the teaching of Tawakkul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

14. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hajj has no place in daily life.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hajj with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Hajj to insult classmates of other faiths.

15. Which response best shows understanding of Twahara? (1 mark)
   A. Use Twahara to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Twahara.
   C. Say Twahara has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Twahara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues: Ibadah and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Virtues and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Adalah, Justice 02 5.3 Prohibitions in Islam, Intoxicants 03 5.4 Israf,extravaga and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

19. In three clear sentences, explain Prohibitions in Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

21. In three clear sentences, explain Fair treatment of workers 03 6.2 Relationship with people of other faiths 03 6.3 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

22. In three clear sentences, explain Relationship with people of other faiths 03 6.3 Corruption 04 7 History of Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

23. In three clear sentences, explain Relations with people of other faiths and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
